cases.purpose: With CPUID leaf 1 AVX and leaf 7 AVX2/BMI bits masked by a ptrace CPUID-faulting emulator right after execve, an unset or auto BASHVEC_BACKEND selects sse2 (never avx2), a forced avx2 does not report avx2, and exact sum/min/max/dot over i32/u32/i64/f32/f64 vectors of 1..65 elements still match an independent Python model; an unmasked control selects avx2.
cases.oracle: Independent Python model of the reductions (integer or dyadic-float arithmetic); backend names from the documented BASHVEC_BACKEND selection; CPUID emulation passes the real CPUID values except the masked feature bits.
cases.comparison: Candidate output, status and files compared with values derived independently of candidate output.

files.cpuidmask.py:
#!/usr/bin/python3
"""Run PROGRAM with CPUID faulting enabled right after execve and emulate every CPUID in a ptrace loop,
masking AVX (leaf 1 ECX bit 28) and AVX2/BMI (leaf 7 EBX bits 3,5,8). Usage: cpuidmask.py [--keep-avx2] -- PROGRAM [ARG...]
Stats "cpuid=<n>" on stderr at exit when CPUIDSTATS is set. Forks are not followed."""
import ctypes, mmap, os, signal, struct, sys

keep = False
argv = sys.argv[1:]
if argv and argv[0] == "--keep-avx2":
    keep = True; argv = argv[1:]
assert argv[0] == "--"
prog = argv[1:]
libc = ctypes.CDLL(None, use_errno=True)
libc.ptrace.restype = ctypes.c_long
libc.ptrace.argtypes = [ctypes.c_long, ctypes.c_long, ctypes.c_void_p, ctypes.c_void_p]
TRACEME, PEEKTEXT, POKETEXT, CONT, SINGLESTEP, GETREGS, SETREGS, GETSIGINFO = 0, 1, 4, 7, 9, 12, 13, 0x4202

class Regs(ctypes.Structure):
    _fields_ = [(n, ctypes.c_ulonglong) for n in
                "r15 r14 r13 r12 rbp rbx r11 r10 r9 r8 rax rcx rdx rsi rdi orig_rax rip cs eflags rsp ss fs_base gs_base ds es fs gs".split()]

code = bytes.fromhex("53" "89f8" "89f1" "4989d0" "0fa2" "418900" "41895804" "41894808" "4189500c" "5b" "c3")
mem = mmap.mmap(-1, 4096, prot=mmap.PROT_READ | mmap.PROT_WRITE | mmap.PROT_EXEC)
mem.write(code)
addr = ctypes.addressof(ctypes.c_char.from_buffer(mem))
native = ctypes.CFUNCTYPE(None, ctypes.c_uint32, ctypes.c_uint32, ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_uint32 * 4))(addr)

def cpuid(leaf, sub):
    out = (ctypes.c_uint32 * 4)()
    native(leaf, sub, ctypes.pointer(out))
    return list(out)

pid = os.fork()
if pid == 0:
    libc.ptrace(TRACEME, 0, None, None)
    os.execv(prog[0], prog)
    os._exit(127)

def wait():
    _, st = os.waitpid(pid, 0)
    return st

st = wait()
assert os.WIFSTOPPED(st), st
regs = Regs()
libc.ptrace(GETREGS, pid, None, ctypes.byref(regs))
saved = Regs.from_buffer_copy(regs)
word = libc.ptrace(PEEKTEXT, pid, ctypes.c_void_p(regs.rip), None) & 0xffffffffffffffff
patched = (word & ~0xffff) | 0x050f
libc.ptrace(POKETEXT, pid, ctypes.c_void_p(regs.rip), ctypes.c_void_p(patched))
regs.rax = 158; regs.rdi = 0x1012; regs.rsi = 0; regs.orig_rax = 0xffffffffffffffff
libc.ptrace(SETREGS, pid, None, ctypes.byref(regs))
libc.ptrace(SINGLESTEP, pid, None, None)
st = wait()
chk = Regs()
libc.ptrace(GETREGS, pid, None, ctypes.byref(chk))
if chk.rax != 0:
    sys.stderr.write("cpuidmask: ARCH_SET_CPUID failed rax=%d\n" % ctypes.c_longlong(chk.rax).value)
    os.kill(pid, signal.SIGKILL); sys.exit(125)
libc.ptrace(POKETEXT, pid, ctypes.c_void_p(saved.rip), ctypes.c_void_p(word))
libc.ptrace(SETREGS, pid, None, ctypes.byref(saved))

n = 0
sig = 0
while True:
    libc.ptrace(CONT, pid, None, ctypes.c_void_p(sig))
    sig = 0
    st = wait()
    if os.WIFEXITED(st):
        code_ = os.WEXITSTATUS(st); break
    if os.WIFSIGNALED(st):
        code_ = 128 + os.WTERMSIG(st); break
    s = os.WSTOPSIG(st)
    if s == signal.SIGSEGV:
        r = Regs()
        libc.ptrace(GETREGS, pid, None, ctypes.byref(r))
        w = libc.ptrace(PEEKTEXT, pid, ctypes.c_void_p(r.rip), None) & 0xffff
        if w == 0xa20f:
            leaf, sub = r.rax & 0xffffffff, r.rcx & 0xffffffff
            a, b, c, d = cpuid(leaf, sub)
            if not keep:
                if leaf == 1:
                    c &= ~(1 << 28)
                elif leaf == 7 and sub == 0:
                    b &= ~((1 << 3) | (1 << 5) | (1 << 8))
            r.rax, r.rbx, r.rcx, r.rdx = a, b, c, d
            r.rip += 2
            libc.ptrace(SETREGS, pid, None, ctypes.byref(r))
            n += 1
            continue
    sig = s if s not in (signal.SIGTRAP,) else 0
if os.environ.get("CPUIDSTATS"):
    sys.stderr.write("cpuid=%d\n" % n)
sys.exit(code_)
files.run.sh:
be=$1
for t in i32 u32 i64 f32 f64; do
  for n in 1 3 4 5 8 9 17 33 65; do
    a=(); b=()
    for ((i=0;i<n;i++)); do
      x=$(( (i*37+11)%201-100 )); y=$(( (i*53+7)%97-48 ))
      [[ $t == u32 ]] && { x=$((x+100)); y=$((y+100)); }
      if [[ $t == f32 || $t == f64 ]]; then x=$x.5; y=$y.5; fi
      a[i]=$x; b[i]=$y
    done
    vec from-array -T $t a -h ha; vec from-array -T $t b -h hb
    vec sum $ha > o.s; read -r s < o.s; vec min $ha > o.n; read -r mn < o.n
    vec max $ha > o.x; read -r mx < o.x; vec dot $ha $hb > o.d; read -r dt < o.d
    printf '%s %s %s sum=%s min=%s max=%s dot=%s\n' "$be" $t $n "$s" "$mn" "$mx" "$dt"
    vec free $ha; vec free $hb
  done
done

cases.script:
M() { /usr/bin/python3 cpuidmask.py "$@"; }
bk='vec backend > b.out; read -r l < b.out; echo "$l"'
printf 'control-unmasked-auto=%s\n' "$(/usr/bin/env -u BASHVEC_BACKEND /usr/bin/python3 cpuidmask.py --keep-avx2 -- "$BASH" --noprofile --norc -c "$bk")"
printf 'masked-unset=%s\n' "$(/usr/bin/env -u BASHVEC_BACKEND /usr/bin/python3 cpuidmask.py -- "$BASH" --noprofile --norc -c "$bk")"
for be in auto sse2 scalar; do printf 'masked-%s=%s\n' $be "$(BASHVEC_BACKEND=$be /usr/bin/python3 cpuidmask.py -- "$BASH" --noprofile --norc -c "$bk")"; done
r=$(BASHVEC_BACKEND=avx2 /usr/bin/python3 cpuidmask.py -- "$BASH" --noprofile --norc -c "$bk"); [[ $r == avx2 ]] && echo masked-avx2-forced=avx2-WRONG || echo masked-avx2-forced=not-avx2
/usr/bin/env -u BASHVEC_BACKEND /usr/bin/python3 cpuidmask.py -- "$BASH" --noprofile --norc ./run.sh masked-auto
BASHVEC_BACKEND=sse2 /usr/bin/python3 cpuidmask.py -- "$BASH" --noprofile --norc ./run.sh masked-sse2
